summary: Issue #70 acceptance criteria are all proven by the committed evidence in the reviewed diff. The four command/exec states are evidenced with real, distinct exit codes (0/3/124/137). Unauthorized host write and network access are denied by the sandbox with no side effects (escapeFileExists=false; stdout empty). Explicit sandboxPolicy is passed on all policy-exercising calls, and both inexpressible-policy classes fail closed (malformed relative writableRoot at deserialization; well-formed but unsupported legacy readOnly.access=restricted at semantic Deserialize, permissions.rs:618-620) with no command execution and no host-shell fallback (markerExists=false in both cases). Cancel cleanup is proven at process-tree level: parent PID 91279 and descendant sleep-47 PID 91288 both present before terminate, both empty after terminate, with exitCode 137. The prior review's blocker (tree cleanup), major (semantic blocked path), and two minor findings (default-permission inheritance, transcript PII) are each addressed by a new passing case or by scrub(). No codex-rs core changes, no weakened acceptance, no secrets committed.

criteria_verified.criterion: command/exec 成功/失败/超时/取消四态
criteria_verified.evidence: cases.json success ('print(gate-ok)' -> stdout marker, exitCode 0), failure (sys.exit(3) -> exitCode 3), timeout (sleep 10 -> exitCode 124), cancel (sleep 30 -> exitCode 137 with sleepBeforeTerminate present and sleepAfterTerminate empty). summary.json allPass=true; exec-gate-conclusion.md documents the four codes as distinct and reliable.

criteria_verified.criterion: 越权写入与网络限制被沙箱阻止
criteria_verified.evidence: escapeWrite writes to /Users/<user>/p0-7-escape-probe.txt outside writableRoots: result exitCode 1, stderr 'PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted', escapeFileExists=false. networkBlocked (networkAccess=false) yields empty stdout (no 'NET-OK') and socket PermissionError; the stdout-only check avoids a stderr-traceback false match and tightens rather than weakens the assertion.

criteria_verified.criterion: 显式传入沙箱策略；无法表达当前策略时返回 blocked，不退回宿主 shell
criteria_verified.evidence: All policy-exercising calls carry an explicit workspaceWrite sandboxPolicy. invalidPolicyBlocked (relative writableRoot) is rejected -32600 with marker not created. semanticPolicyBlocked sends well-formed readOnly {access:{type:'restricted'}} and receives -32600 'readOnly.access is no longer supported; use permissionProfile for restricted reads' from SandboxPolicy Deserialize (appendix permissions.rs:618-620), with markerExists=false and rejectionIsSemantic=true — the exact semantic-rejection fix the prior major finding required. Both paths fail closed with no command execution and no host-shell fallback.

criteria_verified.criterion: 取消后确认子进程树清理
criteria_verified.evidence: cancelTree case: parent python spawns detached descendant sleep-47. parentBefore '91279 ...Python... # p07-tree-parent' and descendantBefore '91288 sleep 47' both non-empty before command/exec/terminate (id 11, result {}, no error); parentAfter and descendantAfter both empty after terminate; execResponse exitCode 137, stdout 'TREE-PARENT-READY\n'. Exercises the process-group escalation path cited from core/src/exec.rs:1041-1101 (terminate_process_group + grace + kill_process_group), fixing the prior blocker.

criteria_verified.criterion: 验收：门禁程序退出码可靠；越权被阻；取消有清理证据
criteria_verified.evidence: Exit codes 0/3/124/137 are distinct and map to success/failure/timeout/SIGKILL-escalated-cancel, so a VerificationExecutor gate can branch on them directly. escapeWrite and networkBlocked are denied without side effects. cancel and cancelTree both provide pgrep before/after evidence that the process (and its tree) is reaped. summary.json has allPass values true for all 11 cases.

residual_notes: The managed-constraint rejection path (can_set_legacy_sandbox_policy -> can_set_permission_profile blocking a policy under a managed permission profile) is not exercised because it requires a managed environment; exec-gate-conclusion.md documents this as a deployment-time constraint rather than a P0 gap. This does not block the P0 behavior: fail-closed no-host-shell-fallback is demonstrated via two concrete rejection paths.

defaultPolicyNoHostWrite proves the no-explicit-policy fallback (processor else branch, command_exec_processor.rs:242-262) does not grant host-level write; it cannot fully distinguish 'restricted default' from 'no approval inheritance' in isolation, but it satisfies the safety property the minor finding asked to document.
